business_questions: How many defects are open versus closed?
How are defects distributed by priority and status?
Which projects, components, environments, and assignees have the greatest defect concentration?
Which defects are customer-impacting or have breached SLA?
What is the age profile of open defects?
How many defects were created by month and priority?
How do actual KPI results compare with ExpectedKPIs values after their semantics are confirmed?

kpis.name: Total Defects
kpis.definition: Distinct count of FactDefects[IssueKey], subject to validation that IssueKey is unique.

kpis.name: Open Defects
kpis.definition: Count of open defects using OpenFlag or validated open-status logic.

kpis.name: Closed Defects
kpis.definition: Count of closed defects using ClosedFlag or validated closed-status logic.

kpis.name: Open Defect Rate
kpis.definition: Open defects divided by total defects with explicit zero handling.

kpis.name: SLA Breached Defects
kpis.definition: Count of defects whose SLABreached value indicates breach; exact category requires confirmation.

kpis.name: SLA Breach Rate
kpis.definition: SLA-breached defects divided by the approved business denominator.

kpis.name: Customer Impacting Defects
kpis.definition: Count of defects whose CustomerImpact value indicates customer impact.

kpis.name: High Severity Defects
kpis.definition: Count of defects in the approved highest-severity categories using DimPriority[SeverityRank].

kpis.name: Monthly Created Defects
kpis.definition: Sum of MonthlyTrend[DefectCount] by CreatedMonth and Priority, pending reconciliation with FactDefects.

kpis.name: KPI Variance
kpis.definition: Actual KPI value minus the matching ExpectedKPIs[ExpectedValue], only after target semantics are confirmed.

model_changes.change: Create a valid relationship from FactDefects to DimDate, with deliberate handling of CreatedDate, UpdatedDate, and ResolvedDate.
model_changes.reason: No current relationship connects the issue-level fact to DimDate; the fact date fields are Int64.

model_changes.change: Repair DimProject column names and create a project relationship using a stable project key.
model_changes.reason: DimProject contains only Column1 through Column4 and is disconnected.

model_changes.change: Add explicit measures and validate IssueKey grain and uniqueness.
model_changes.reason: The model currently has zero explicit measures and KPI count semantics are not documented.

model_changes.change: Disable or remove unnecessary auto-date tables after DimDate is made authoritative.
model_changes.reason: Generated DateTableTemplate and two LocalDateTable objects coexist with DimDate.

model_changes.change: Reconcile and govern MonthlyTrend as an aggregate or replace trend logic with issue-level fact logic.
model_changes.reason: MonthlyTrend is a separate pre-aggregated table and may not match distinct issue counts.

model_changes.change: Confirm whether ExpectedKPIs contains targets, test expectations, or sample values and design the comparison accordingly.
Set non-additive date attributes and ranking fields to None summarization, configure month sorting, mark the calendar table, hide technical keys, and add descriptions.
model_changes.reason: Several numeric attributes default to sum; visible objects lack descriptions and technical relationship columns are not hidden.

assumptions: The Excel workbook referenced by the PBIP is the source for all imported tables.
IssueKey may identify a defect, but uniqueness must be validated.
The exact values and meanings of OpenFlag, ClosedFlag, SLABreached, and CustomerImpact require profiling and stakeholder confirmation.
The encoding of FactDefects date fields is not assumed from their Int64 data type.
MonthlyTrend is pre-aggregated and must be reconciled with issue-level counts.
ExpectedKPIs may be targets, acceptance criteria, or sample expectations; the model does not document which.
The existing report has one blank page and no visuals, filters, or slicers.
This is a planning-only phase; no DAX, PBIR, or semantic-model changes are authorized.
implementation_sequence: Profile source values, fact grain, issue-key uniqueness, date encoding, categorical values, and ExpectedKPIs semantics.
Repair project and date modeling, clean up auto-date infrastructure, set semantic properties, and document fields.
Add and validate approved explicit measures with appropriate formats.
Reconcile MonthlyTrend with issue-level fact results and decide whether it remains a governed aggregate.
Build and validate Executive Defect Health.
Build and validate Backlog and SLA Risk and Trend and Mix.
Build and validate Project and Ownership View and Defect Detail.
Validate PBIR bindings, interactions, filters, accessibility, and representative totals in Power BI Desktop.
Obtain stakeholder approval before publishing or promoting the PBIP.
